name: Imagera API
description: REST API for generating and editing images, video, voice and music with many AI models through one key and one queue-based interface.
notes: Public OpenAPI 3 spec (https://api.imagera.ai/openapi.json) and agent-readable docs (https://api.imagera.ai/llms.txt) for image, video, voice and music models behind one endpoint (https://api.imagera.ai). Auth is an API key in the Authorization header. Paid, billed per request; no free tier.
